newsitem.title: FINLAND: Cultor specifies earnings forecast - RFTV.
newsitem.headline: Cultor specifies earnings forecast - RFTV.

text.p: Finnish sweetener, feeds and bakery group Cultor Oy's earlier forecast of 1997 profits close to the 1995 level referred to earnings per share, CEO Bjorn Mattsson told Reuters Financial Television (RFTV) on Thursday.
"We are looking at earnings per share," Mattsson said in an interview when asked to specify the earnings outlook.
Cultor's board wanted authorisation to issue four million shares to be able to quickly finance new projects such as acquisitions or technology, but Cultor had no particular plans, he said.
Cultor earlier reported 1996 earnings per share falling to 12.71 markka from 14.91 markka in 1995.
